nodes.summary: For every commutative semiring $R$ and every $x \in R$, Horner evaluation at $x$ with no coefficients ($n = 0$) returns $0$ and charges $0$ operations.
nodes.title: Horner evaluation of the empty coefficient list

nodes.summary: For every commutative semiring $R$, every $x \in R$ and all coefficients $a_0, \dots, a_{n-1} \in R$, the value returned by Horner evaluation of $a_0, \dots, a_{n-1}$ at $x$ equals $p(x)$, where $p = a_0 + a_1 X + \dots + a_{n-1} X^{n-1} \in R[X]$ is the polynomial with these coefficients.
nodes.title: Horner evaluation is polynomial evaluation

nodes.summary: For every commutative semiring $R$, every $x \in R$ and all coefficients $a_0, \dots, a_{n-1} \in R$, the value returned by Horner evaluation of $a_0, \dots, a_{n-1}$ at $x$ is $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1} a_i x^i$.
nodes.title: Horner evaluation computes the coefficient sum

nodes.summary: For every commutative semiring $R$, every $x \in R$ and every single coefficient $a_0 \in R$ ($n = 1$), Horner evaluation of $a_0$ at $x$ returns $a_0$ and charges $2$ operations.
nodes.title: Horner evaluation of a constant polynomial

nodes.summary: For every commutative semiring $R$, every $x \in R$ and all coefficients $a_0, \dots, a_{n-1} \in R$, Horner evaluation of $a_0, \dots, a_{n-1}$ at $x$ charges exactly $2n$ operations, one multiplication and one addition per coefficient.
nodes.title: Horner evaluation uses $2n$ operations

nodes.summary: For every commutative semiring $R$ and all coefficients $a_0, \dots, a_n \in R$ (at least one coefficient), the value returned by Horner evaluation of $a_0, \dots, a_n$ at $x = 0$ is $a_0$.
nodes.title: Horner evaluation at zero

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative semiring, let $x \in R$, and let $a_0, \dots, a_{n-1} \in R$ be coefficients listed in ascending order of degree. Horner evaluation starts with the accumulator $v = 0$ and, for $i = n-1, \dots, 0$ in turn, replaces $v$ by $a_i + x v$, charging two operations (one multiplication and one addition) for each step. It returns the final accumulator together with the total number of operations…
nodes.title: Horner evaluation with operation count

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
